Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug** in #inc-vtg-hartford. Your message said both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scan, and the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard.

The channel has nothing else about the guard in the meantime. At 11:03 AM Mateo wrote that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. You then confirmed both lanes were working at 11:07 AM.
